I can’t reliably evaluate this many swaps by hand. Since the assignments are valid R code, append the following in the same R session to print the requested line with the exact final values:

```r
vars <- letters[1:16]
vals <- vapply(vars, function(x) as.character(get(x, envir = .GlobalEnv)), "")
cat("ANSWER: ",
    paste(sprintf("%s ?= %s", vars, vals), collapse = "; "),
    "; TMP ?= ", as.character(TMP), ";\n", sep = "")
```
